entry.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
entry.note: Credentials against the AI management system standard the compliance section tracks
entry.audience: AI management system implementers and auditors

covers: Regulatory and ethical considerations for AI implementation
Aligning AI initiatives with business objectives
Developing and implementing an AI management system
Evaluating quality, reliability, and performance of AI systems
Ensuring AI solutions meet standards and function as intended
Framework for fairness, transparency, accountability, and privacy
reading.summary: This training covers ISO/IEC 42001, which specifies requirements and guidance for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an artificial intelligence management system. Holding the certificate demonstrates the ability to plan, develop, implement, maintain, and improve such a system. It also shows competence in addressing regulatory, ethical, quality, and risk aspects of AI.
reading.audience: Individuals seeking proficiency in artificial intelligence management systems.
